items.html: And if you say, the place beneath the mouth would be fitting to call it the first correction — know that the matter does not depend on this; rather, one must assess the place itself, whether it is upper or not, and close to the place of the breath. And at times there are upper places that are higher than the place of the breath; and this matter depends on the assessment that the Emanator, may He be blessed, made of the places, in the order of the thirteen corrections of the beard, in the manner that we shall explain.
